label: Dental clinics
description: Compare dental clinics in Abuja on public ratings, how they respond, specialist services, safety and how openly they publish prices and hours.

gates.label: We have verified that a practitioner there is registered with the Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria.

measures.label: Public rating
measures.note: Three reviews of 5 stars should not beat three hundred reviews averaging 4.7.

measures.label: Recent reviews
measures.note: We count reviews from the last 6 months.

items.label: the clinic has replied to at least half of its last 10 reviews
it answers an enquiry we send within one working day
it publishes prices or price ranges
it publishes its address and opening hours
it publishes payment or instalment options for larger treatments

measures.label: Specialist services
measures.note: Examples are orthodontics (braces), dental implants, root canal treatment, oral surgery, paediatric dentistry and gum care. A service counts only when a practitioner with a recognised specialist qualification provides it and we have verified that.

measures.label: Safety and facilities

items.label: it has a working autoclave with instruments kept in sealed packs
it keeps an emergency kit with oxygen and emergency drugs
it gives a written treatment plan and price quote before treatment

measures.note: A check counts only when we have seen evidence, such as a dated photo or video, or we have visited. A clinic's own claim earns nothing.
